shapes.rules: One or two representative inputs. Assert the exact return value, never its type or its length.
Empty input, one element, and the value either side of each limit. One test per boundary, exact values.
The inputs the contract rejects. Assert the error type, and that the message names the offending value.

functions.name: roundTo
functions.notes: Half away from zero, so -0.5 rounds to -1 rather than to 0. Negative decimals round to tens and hundreds.

functions.name: percentChange
functions.notes: Throws RangeError when `from` is 0. The denominator is |from|, so a rise from -10 to -5 is +0.5.

functions.name: gcd
functions.notes: Of the magnitudes, and of the truncated values: gcd(-12, 8) is 4 and gcd(0, 0) is 0.

functions.name: mean
functions.notes: An empty list has a mean of 0, which is a decision rather than a mathematical fact.

functions.name: median
functions.notes: Numeric sort on a copy — the input is never reordered. An even count gives the mean of the middle two; empty gives 0.
